column1: hardware LAG configuration

The problem arises when a user configures Equal-Cost Multipath (ECMP).
In ECMP mode
column2: traffic can be directed to different physical ports based on

column1: the queue affinity
column2: which is intended for use by VPORTS other than the

column1: E-Switch manager. ECMP mode is supported only if both E-Switch managers are
in switchdev mode and the appropriate route is configured via IP. In this
configuration
column2: the RDMA device is not destroyed

column1: device that is not marked as LAG-enabled.
To ensure correct behavior
column2: Send Queues (SQs) opened by the E-Switch

column1: manager through verbs should be assigned strict affinity. This means they
